Fills available for that row: Pressure=6.3 MPa (design AND operating), Operator/运行单位=江西省天然气集团有限公司, FuelSource evidence (this is the branch tied to 西三线瑞金分输清管站, i.e. the WEP3 end of the family), endpoint coordinates for §8 route work, and 2017-12-28 赣州市环境保护局 EIA approval. Status support: the same daily-patrol / operating-pressure / staffed-station evidence applies (the plan covers all four branches as live assets).

全南县发改委 2021 request states the four-branch project's approved total investment as 213,691万元, raised by ~3,569万元 to 217,260万元, with 项目资本金约43452万元 and 「其余80%资金由省天然气公司申请银行贷款解决」; 建设单位 is 江西省天然气集团有限公司; land pre-approval 用字第360000202100006号 / 赣市自然资字〔2021〕9号; approval authority 江西省能源局. This is the ONLY cost figure for the family and it is an aggregate over 537.5 km — usable as a family-level note on P4785/P4786/P4787/P4788 but not as any row's SegmentCost.

2022 CCXI credit-rating report for 江西省天然气集团有限公司 (different host/class than the already-catalogued SSE bond report) confirms the Group's Phase II network (all West-East-2-sourced branches, including Ganzhou South/信丰-瑞金) is operated by the wholly Group-owned '江西省天然气集团有限公司管道分公司' (管道分公司) -- NOT the 54%/46% Jiangxi-Natural-Gas-Group/PipeChina joint entity '天然气管道公司', which the footnote states operates ONLY the Phase I (Chuan-qi-dong-song-sourced) network. If P4788's Operator [ref] mechanically reused the SSE 54/46 split, the same phase-specific correction likely applies.

Same table also gives 定南一龙南 35.9, 龙南→信丰 27.5, 安远一定南 73.4, 安远一寻乌 45.5, 会昌一安远 80.4, 宁都一广昌 80, 广昌-南丰 72.5, 西二线瑞金一会昌 51.3, 西一线瑞金-石城 43.6, 西二线于都宁都 58.5, 西一线于都一于都 33.1, 赣州南康 17, 安义一湾里一昌北 41 — useful planning-length candidates (medium at best; one origin, and the 龙南一全南 24.6 entry proves these are notional pre-EIA figures) for the other Jiangxi county rows. NOTE: the 2024 operator plan's four branches do NOT include 大余-信丰, so P4785 is outside that approval.

Two things for whoever holds the Dayu-Xinfeng row. (1) The quannan 2024 plan's four Ganzhou-south branches are 信丰-瑞金段, 龙南-全南段, 会昌－寻乌段 and 上犹-崇义段 -- 大余-信丰段 is NOT one of them, so the 217,260万元 four-branch approval does not cover it; 大余-信丰段 is listed separately as item 14 赣州南支线（大余 -信丰段）in Jiangxi's 2021 key-projects list https://www.sohu.com/a/466792472_661255, and the 2014 provincial plan (赣发改规划[2014]325号) gives 大余-信丰 as 36 km. (2) UNASSIGNED SIBLING: the 上犹-崇义段 branch (43 km per the plan's prose, DN250, 6.3 MPa, 0.9×10^8 Nm3/a; item 24 上犹 -崇义段 in the 2021 list) -- if a GEM row exists for it, note that table 3-8 of the plan MIS-PRINTS its length as 97.5 km (copying the 会昌-寻乌段 row); the prose figure 43 km is the correct one. (3) jxnews https://tt.jxnews.com.cn/news/1266077 says the 瑞金分输站 feeds 会昌、寻乌、安远、定南、龙南、全南、信丰、大余 (8 counties) off 赣州南支线 and that WEP2's 149# valve chamber at Dayu is the second gas source -- relevant to any Dayu row's FuelSource.
